name: PENGWIN 2024 Task 2 synthetic X-rays
what: 50,000 DeepDRR images with 2D fragment masks from 100 pelvic-fracture CTs at 500 random C-arm poses each; projections 0250-0499 add up to 10 simulated K-wires and screws; pelvis, sacrum and the lower lumbar spine are in field; Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.10913195, mirrored at huggingface.co/datasets/MedOtter/PENGWIN_Task2
level_truth: none in 2D; from the Task 1 CTs by pose (the manifest's pengwin2026, already on the grid)
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; a 2D product of the challenge's CTs already on the grid; the only large public DRR set rendered with real C-arm poses and simulated hardware, so pelvic-ring and sacral appearance under instruments without any patient
licence: CC BY, to confirm on the page; the challenge page lists its terms
how_to_get: Read the terms on https://pengwin.grand-challenge.org/ and the licence line on Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.10913195.

Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py zenodo-get --record 10913195 --dest DIR, or from the mirror python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py hf-get --repo MedOtter/PENGWIN_Task2 --repo-type dataset --dest DIR.
